project_type: MERN Stack — Express/Node.js backend + React/Vite frontend, MongoDB via Mongoose
language: JavaScript (CommonJS backend, ESModules frontend with JSX)
build_system: Backend: node server.js (no transpile). Frontend: Vite (npm run dev / npm run build). No monorepo tooling.
test_framework: No automated test framework present. Verification is manual: start backend with 'cd backend && node server.js', start frontend with 'cd frontend && npm run dev', then use the browser/Postman.
build_command: cd backend && node server.js (backend); cd frontend && npm run build (frontend)
test_command: Manual: start both servers and exercise endpoints via Postman or browser. Backend: 'node server.js' must start without errors. Frontend: 'npm run build' must complete with no errors.
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && node server.js — watch for startup errors. 2. For each new route, test with curl or Postman. 3. cd frontend && npm run build — must produce no TS/lint errors. 4. Open localhost:5173 in browser and exercise the relevant dashboard page.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine. PowerShell is the shell. Paths use backslashes but Node.js accepts forward slashes. Do NOT delete any existing files without reading them first. The AI service (Python/FastAPI on port 8001) is optional — all new endpoints must work without it.
contribution_requirements: Use express-async-handler for all async controller handlers. All new models must use mongoose.Schema. Routes must be registered in server.js. Frontend service calls go through the api axios instance in frontend/src/services/api.js.
key_patterns: 1. Controllers: const asyncHandler = require('express-async-handler'); every handler is asyncHandler(async(req,res)=>{...}). 2. Notifications: createAndNotify(req.app, { recipient, title, message, type, priority, link }). 3. Routes: protect middleware from authMiddleware for private, admin middleware for admin-only. 4. Frontend services: import { api } from './api'; export const fn = () => api.get('/path'). 5. ActivityLog.create({user, action, details, ip, userAgent}) pattern in feedbackController. 6. AIStudentProfile: unique per user, has skillProfile[], learningRoadmap[], strengths[], weaknesses[]. 7. SkillAssessment (EXISTING): simple schema {user, skill, level, score, source, assessedAt} — NOT the new SkillEvidence model.
directory_structure: backend/controllers/ — all Express controller files; backend/models/ — Mongoose models; backend/routes/ — Express routers; backend/utils/ — helpers (notificationHelper, atsScoring, etc.); backend/services/ — aiServiceClient; backend/server.js — root registration; frontend/src/services/ — Axios call wrappers; frontend/src/components/dashboard/student/ — student dashboard tab components; frontend/src/components/career/ — reusable career UI cards; frontend/src/pages/ — full page components
